description: Constructed TSS mechanism-check positions (iter-52 §1.3, Check A). Coordinates are [x, y]. 'expected' lists every winning first move verified by hand (see iter-52.md §1.3 for the lines); 'refuted' lists forcing moves that LOOK winning but are refuted by a defender reply (TSS must NOT return them). The VCF controls (vcf-1, vcf-2, vcf-two-four-sequence) come from the tactical suites, not this file.
